claim.quote: The results (85.48 kg d) improve the best present existing limits on the WIMP-neutron spin-dependent cross-section (obtained from {sup 129}Xe) for low WIMP masses

key_value.note: Exposure of the analysis; the abstract gives no cross-section value.

name: Limits on the spin-dependent WIMP-neutron cross section from HDMS (as reported in a 2006 Physica Scripta paper citing Phys. Lett. B 609, 226)
notes: The primary paper is Klapdor-Kleingrothaus et al., Phys. Lett. B 609 (2005) 226-231, which could not be read (not on arXiv; publisher page blocked); this record rests on the 2006 conference paper's abstract that cites it. The abstract states the exposure but no cross-section value.

published.quote: Journal Name: Physica Scripta (Online); Journal Volume: 2006; Journal Issue: T127

summary.plain: With its enriched germanium-73 crystal, HDMS gave a better limit than xenon-129 experiments on how strongly light dark matter particles could couple to neutrons.
summary.technical: HDMS inner detector of enriched 73Ge (the only Ge isotope with nuclear spin); 85.48 kg d; spin-dependent WIMP-neutron cross-section limit improving the xenon-129 limit at low WIMP masses.

title: Limits on the spin-dependent WIMP-neutron cross section from HDMS (as reported in a 2006 Physica Scripta paper citing Phys. Lett. B 609, 226)
why_it_matters: Spin-dependent sensitivity from a germanium target, complementary to xenon and sodium iodide results.
